1.title: Projects, Project Management and the Five Integrated Elements
1.text: Welcome to Module one: Projects, Project Management and the Five Integrated Elements. It covers the exam area Key concepts relating to projects and prince two. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do three things. Recall the integrated elements, the definition of a project and of project management, the aspects of project performance and the delivery approaches. Describe why project management is used, the challenges prince two addresses, the characteristics of a project, projects in context and the features and benefits of prince two. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: Key concepts relating to projects and prince two (three percent). Exam format: sixty multiple-choice questions in sixty minutes; thirty-six correct answers (sixty percent) pass. Validated against: the official prince two seven Foundation syllabus (people cert).

1.title: What PRINCE2 is
1.text: What prince two is. prince two is a project management method: a structured, flexible way to plan, delegate, monitor and control a project. It can be tailored to any project, whatever its size, type or setting. prince two has five integrated elements. Principles. Seven guiding obligations and good practices. People. Leading, managing and involving everyone affected. Practices. Seven areas that must be addressed throughout the project. Processes. Seven stages of the project life, from start to close. Project context. The environment the project lives in, which tailoring responds to.

1.title: What PRINCE2 is, continued
1.text: What prince two is. The figure shows this: The five integrated elements of prince two.

1.title: What PRINCE2 is, continued
1.text: What prince two is. The sixth edition had principles, themes, processes and tailoring. In prince two seven the themes became practices, people was added, and tailoring sits inside project context. Exam tip: Principles, people, practices, processes, project context are the five integrated elements. If an option says themes, it is the old wording.

1.title: Project and project management
1.text: Project and project management. Project. A temporary organization created to deliver one or more business products according to an agreed business case. Project management. Planning, delegating, monitoring and controlling all aspects of the project, and motivating the people involved, to meet the project's objectives within the agreed performance targets. Characteristics of a project: change, temporary, cross-functional, unique, uncertain.

1.title: Aspects of project performance (managed throughout)
1.text: Aspects of project performance (managed throughout). prince two seven lists seven aspects: benefits, risks, quality, scope, cost, time and sustainability. The sixth edition listed six; sustainability is the new one. Exam tip: A question that asks which aspect was added in prince two seven has one answer: sustainability.

1.title: Why projects need management, and what PRINCE2 offers
1.text: Why projects need management, and what prince two offers. Common challenges projects face: unclear objectives, changing requirements, scope creep, unrealistic plans, weak ownership, poor communication, late discovery of problems, and loss of the business reason for doing the work. Features and benefits of prince two include: a focus on the business case, defined roles and responsibilities, control by stages and by exception, a product focus, proven and widely recognized good practice, and tailoring to suit the project.

1.title: Delivery approaches and project context
1.text: Delivery approaches and project context. Linear-sequential. Work is done in order; each phase finishes before the next. Iterative-incremental. Work is done in repeated cycles; the product is built up in increments. Hybrid. A mix of the two. prince two works with any approach. The project context (organization, environment, programme or portfolio setting, delivery approach, culture) decides how the method is tailored. Exam tip: A project is temporary. Any option that calls a project a permanent organization is wrong.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Which list names the five integrated elements of prince two seven? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Principles, people, practices, processes, project context. Option A is mixed old wording; C and D are practices.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. Which statements about a project are C O R R E C T? (one) A project is a temporary organization. (two) A project is created to deliver one or more business products. (three) A project is permanent. (four) A project has no business case. The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: one and two. A project is temporary and delivers business products.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Identify the missing word. Project management is the planning, delegating, monitoring and controlling of all aspects of the project to achieve its objectives within the agreed blank. The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Performance targets. The management is judged against the performance targets.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which aspect of project performance was added in prince two seven? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Sustainability. Sustainability is the new aspect.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A team builds a product in repeated cycles, adding to it each time. Which delivery approach is this? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Iterative-incremental. Repeated cycles that build in increments are iterative-incremental.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. In prince two seven, what are the old prince two themes now called? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Practices. The themes became practices.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. Define a project. Answer: A temporary organization created to deliver one or more business products according to an agreed business case. Question two. Name the five integrated elements. Answer: Principles, people, practices, processes and project context. Question three. Name the seven aspects of project performance. Answer: Benefits, risks, quality, scope, cost, time and sustainability.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Name the three delivery approaches. Answer: Linear-sequential, iterative-incremental and hybrid. Question five. How many principles, practices and processes are there? Answer: Seven of each. Question six. What does tailoring respond to? Answer: The project context.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Elements: principles, people, practices, processes, project context. Project: temporary organization delivering business products for a business case. Aspects: benefits, risks, quality, scope, cost, time, sustainability. Delivery: linear-sequential, iterative-incremental, hybrid. Old wording: themes.
